1.2 signing in getting started for the first sign-in, open the system using the link you received, then log in with the following credentials: user name admin password admin123 caution as soon as you have created your own superuser account with the wizard, the admin user is deactivated automatically and can no longer be used to sign in.

1.3 steps of the setup wizard getting started the wizard starts automatically at the first sign-in. you can also start it at any time later from the system → other → setup wizard menu. 1 selecting the country specify the country in which you use infinity and where you will issue invoices. 2 entering company data enter your company's basic data (company name, address, tax number, bank account number). without these, invoicing cannot operate in line with the legislation. 3 setting up sites if you operate at several sites, enter them here. even with a single site, fill in the data of the registered office. 4 defining warehouses assign the warehouses to the sites. under stock type, specify whether you sell from own or consignment stock. to receive returns, set up a separate warehouse and stock type. 5 selecting currencies select the currency or currencies in which you will invoice. 6 invoice and receipt blocks by default the system creates one customer and one supplier invoice block. if you need more invoice or receipt blocks, record them here. 7 entering vat rates enter the vat rates applied in your business. ask your accountant for help with this. 8 recording bank accounts record your bank account numbers. also enter the iban and the swift code if you have them. 9 connecting nav online invoice under hungarian law, issued invoices must be submitted to the server of the tax authority (nav). failing to do so may result in a substantial fine. create the technical user in the nav online system: https://onlineszamla.nav.gov.hu/felhasznalok/uj/technikai ✖ mandatory setting configuring the nav online invoice function is a legal obligation. if you skip it, the invoices you issue will not reach the authority's system, which may lead to a fine. 10 enabling e-mail templates enable the e-mail templates you want to use and, if necessary, adjust the default texts. click the “back to home page” button to finish the basic configuration. next steps after the basic configuration, continue with users and roles (system → users), then load the partner master data (office → partners).

1.4 support and error reporting getting started in case of an error or a problem you can ask for help at the support@orc.hu e-mail address. mandatory attachments for an error report a screenshot of the error and the url (browser address) where the problem occurred. without these, troubleshooting is significantly slower.

2 the framework the framework infinity is a modular enterprise resource planning system in which the integration of the individual areas allows every department of the company to work with a single management system. since it is web-based software, it can be reached from anywhere — all it takes to use it is an internet connection. it can be operated on a personal computer, a tablet and a mobile phone as well. the result of its operation is a well-structured, efficiently managed business with up-to-date information, working with the shortest possible reaction time. its main characteristics per module: administration management of several sites an unlimited number of users setting up individual user permissions task management module full customisability partner management unified master data management recording custom data defined by the user retrieving fresh, up-to-date partner data from the company register crm integrated into every process online document management, paperless office solutions recording work schedules, managing leave, printing attendance sheets creating google forms automatic e-mail communication integrated into the business process crm customer rating on the basis of individually customisable criteria an automated sales process that can be built on workflows establishing and supporting marketing campaigns task allocation integrated into the business process recording the working time of employees and assigning it to tasks efficient customer service unas webshop management managing an unlimited number of webshops in parallel uploading products immediate, automatic refresh of stock changes electronic invoicing at the press of a button, or automatically sales creating, recording and tracking quotations and orders creating an order from a quotation, managing reservations several document blocks; stock-based sales (with a delivery note) and service invoices individual or template-based recording handling unique (factory number) and serial number barcodes, use of a barcode reader integration of web sales, unas website integration recording and accepting customer cards, vouchers and coupons creating an advance payment request or an advance invoice, final invoicing fixed or percentage discount, individual pricing possibility for both receipts and invoices issuing invoices in a foreign language; recording documents in foreign currency, an unlimited number of currencies handling settlements in foreign currency 6 basic document templates, each of which can be adapted to individual needs data provision for tax authority audits sales statistics filtered by period, product group, outlet and salesperson partner current account card, margin summary of sales retrieving reports to excel or pdf inventory a customisable product master data with an individual structure, tree-structured product group codes serial number management (unique or non-unique) monitoring of minimum stock and minimum margin; uploading an image to an item, printing a barco

3.1 signing in using the system the system can be used by predefined users with specific permissions. every user has a login name and a password. system support and assistance by e-mail: infinity_support@orc.hu, or by phone through your personal contact person. the language of the system can be selected before signing in. infinity supports the following languages: hungarian, german, english. after signing in, the top right corner shows the user's name and the registered office or site the user is assigned to — with several sites, the one the user is signed in to.

3.2 user profile, site and password using the system clicking your user name lets you customise your personal profile: change your own data and password, enable two-factor authentication, upload a profile picture and switch site. to change the password, enter the old password, then the new one twice, and click save. if you have forgotten your password, a user with admin level can reset it to the default. by default the password must be at least 8 characters long.

3.3 permissions using the system on this screen you can review the list of permissions assigned to the given user. they cannot be modified here — this can only be done by a user who holds the appropriate permission.

3.4 two-factor authentication (2fa) using the system two-factor authentication is a security feature that increases the protection of accounts: signing in requires not only a password but also a unique code generated by an authenticator application. steps to enable it: click your name in the top right corner, then select the security settings menu. the system generates a qr code — scan it with an authenticator application (e.g. google authenticator, microsoft authenticator). to confirm activation, enter the 6-digit code shown by the application. after activation, the code generated by the authenticator application must be entered at every sign-in. ⚠ caution if you lose access to the authenticator application, notify the system administrator so that it can be reset.

3.5 signing out using the system leaving the program does not necessarily require signing out — closing the browser window or the whole browser is enough. for a full sign-out, click your name in the top right corner and select sign out.

3.6 automatic sign-out (time out) using the system if you have not made any changes in infinity for a defined period, the system signs you out automatically for security reasons. this prevents others from using a signed-in session that was left unattended. the time limit can be parameterised per company. to resume work, simply sign in again — you can continue where you left off.

3.7 switching site using the system users who have access to several sites can switch between them in the profile menu. ⚠ caution certain site-bound activities are only possible if the user is signed in to that particular site.

3.8 using the menus using the system after entering the user name and password, the start screen appears. the visible menu items and home page widgets depend on the user's permissions. the menu is on the left side of the page. clicking a main menu item expands the submenus or opens the function directly.

3.9 favourites menu using the system at the top of the menu you can create quick access to frequently used functions. click the edit button next to the favourites label, then the create button, to add the functions you want. after adding the function, click save — the menu item appears immediately in the quick menu column on the left.

3.10 widgets using the system when you sign in to the program, the home page appears, where information bars and widgets are displayed depending on your permission level. the widgets support daily work according to individual needs and the permission system. by default they may contain the following: overdue supplier and customer invoices unfinished sales left open products below the minimum stock level stock waiting to be loaded documents waiting for approval vehicles with an expiring registration certificate automatic e-mail sending errors bank and cash desk balances vat, sales information, receivables, payables hr widgets other information related to financial transactions these information panels can be extended further according to individual needs. clicking any row of the information bar opens the related document. for customer invoices — if an e-mail address is recorded for the partner — clicking the e-mail icon sends an immediate payment reminder to the partner, or you can view the overdue invoice.

3.11 buttons, general usage using the system buttons commonly used in the program and their functions: view edit add new copy drop-down function download document search delete clicking the column headers sorts the displayed data alphabetically. you can search by typing into the search fields below the column headers. where a small downward arrow appears at the edge of a search field, you can filter from a drop-down list. the texts displayed in the table are live links — clicking one navigates to the given document. the first column holds the buttons for quick view, edit, sending the document by e-mail and immediate settlement: on pages with a table view, the data can be exported to excel. there are two ways: select the displayed data with the mouse, copy it with ctrl+c / command+c, and paste it into excel. click the button placed above the table list to export the data to excel.

4.1 invoices office here you find the list of customer and supplier invoices as well as advance payment requests. you can filter by fulfilment, issue date, due date, partner and comment. clicking the column headers changes the order of the list. recording a supplier invoice or advance payment request clicking the invoice type lets you record a new supplier invoice or a new supplier advance payment request in the system. when recording a supplier invoice or advance payment request, the partner data must be filled in. if the partner does not yet exist in the system, you have to create it. after selecting the partner, the supplier invoice or advance payment request has to be uploaded. then you can add the items. if the item is not yet in the product master data, you can record it as well. click new item to add an item, or new product to add a new product. after selecting the product, fill in the price data; you can also enter the cost centre, cost category, general ledger account, project number and a comment. after saving, the product is added to the invoice. you can then add further items, remove items, save the invoice as open, or close it. a certificate of completion can be attached to the supplier invoice, and the invoice can also be reversed. copying an invoice when a supplier invoice is copied, the original invoice is duplicated in full and gets open status — all of its data can be modified and edited. you can add new items and change the existing ones. note attaching a document is mandatory when copying as well, because of the filing requirement. handling settlements in the invoice list you can filter for supplier and customer invoices, and within those for settled and open items. filtering by due date is also possible. when the invoice is opened, the balance field shows the unsettled total. depending on the method of settlement, click the cash desk or the transfer button and follow the corresponding process.

4.5 partners office the partner master data stores the partners available to the whole system: customers, suppliers, business contacts (contact persons, freight forwarders) and store networks. the basic settings related to partners can also be made in this module. settings in the settings menu you can manage the following master data: salutations, titles street types postcodes (also assigned to towns) points of sale transfer deadlines (deadlines available for deferred invoicing) partner groups you can create groups from the partners recorded in the system. the groups can be used in commercial reports or in the crm system. you can also create partner group categories, which help in the crm and in customer service tasks. loyalty cards infinity can also manage a loyalty programme. create a loyalty card in the system, fill in the parameters (discount, partner assignment), and when the code is entered at the point of sale the system automatically handles the discounts and the collection of points. partner list creating a partner status when creating a new partner, using the default status is recommended. partners with the default status count as active, can be modified, and documents can be recorded against them. note a partner cannot be deleted, only its status can be changed. no new document can be recorded against a partner with deleted status. the changes do not affect the data of invoices issued earlier. type you can choose from five partner types: private individual — only the full name and the billing address are mandatory company — a hungarian tax number is mandatory; the system validates the tax number both when recording and when issuing an invoice foreign company — the eu vat number is sufficient sole trader — a hungarian tax number is mandatory employee — beyond the normal partner data, the data required for the employment relationship and payroll can also be recorded tax number validation the system validates both when recording (format correctness, duplicate) and when issuing an invoice (real, live tax number). an invoice can only be issued to a partner with a valid tax number. registration filling in the registration controls which partner lists the partner appears in when documents are created. a partner can belong to several categories at the same time (for example, both customer and supplier). possible registration categories: customer, supplier, employee, contact person, freight forwarder, pick-up point, drop-off point. payment deadline the payment deadline typical of the given partner. the system uses this for invoice-based sales. in individual cases it can be overridden when the invoice is issued. e-invoice for a partner flagged for e-invoicing, the system automatically issues an electronic invoice. you can return to paper-based invoicing by clearing the flag. price type the custom price types created in the system can be assigned to the partner here. adding a new customer or supplier click the new partner button, select the type

5.3 cash movements finance  settlement, invoice-level settlement when recording financial transactions it may happen that the item cannot be linked to an invoice. in that case the transaction is posted to the current account of the given partner. these unmatched items can be reviewed in the invoice-level settlement menu. by searching for the partner's name you can list every unmatched item and link them using the check boxes at the beginning of the rows. compensation notices receivables from and liabilities to the same partner can also be settled by compensation. open the new compensation menu and find the partner you need. note if the partner does not have both kinds of open items, the compensation cannot be carried out — the program displays a warning message. if the partner has both supplier and customer invoices, the program lists the invoices that can be involved. the invoices are selected manually. the calculate button computes the amount to be compensated and the remaining balance. you can include or remove invoices by ticking and unticking the check boxes. once the invoices are selected, decide what happens to the invoices left with a balance: include them in a new compensation, or settle them by transfer. finalisation has two levels: the finalise button saves the compensation, and the approve button closes it. a notice can be printed for a closed compensation, or it can be reversed. the execute compensation button performs the actual compensation.

5.3.2 compensation notices receivables from and liabilities to the same partner can also be settled by compensation. open the new compensation menu and find the partner you need. note if the partner does not have both kinds of open items, the compensation cannot be carried out — the program displays a warning message. if the partner has both supplier and customer invoices, the program lists the invoices that can be involved. the invoices are selected manually. the calculate button computes the amount to be compensated and the remaining balance. you can include or remove invoices by ticking and unticking the check boxes. once the invoices are selected, decide what happens to the invoices left with a balance: include them in a new compensation, or settle them by transfer. finalisation has two levels: the finalise button saves the compensation, and the approve button closes it. a notice can be printed for a closed compensation, or it can be reversed. the execute compensation button performs the actual compensation.

5.4 receivables management finance  customer and supplier balances open customer and supplier balances can be queried in this menu — separately or together. the list shows cumulative balances. clicking the eye button opens the partner record: you can see the issued invoices, the payment movements, and the balances at both invoice and line level. tip on the home page the information bar (subject to permissions) automatically lists overdue customer and supplier invoices, so receivables can be tracked without opening this list. balance statement infinity can print balance statements for your partners — either in bulk or one at a time. once you have checked the balances on the receivables management screen, you can use the notify by e-mail function: this sends the balance statement electronically to every partner that has an e-mail address. to send to a single partner, type the name into the search field, select the partner, then send it by e-mail or print it. sent balance statements are stored and can be retrieved from the balance statement list menu. payment reminder you can send payment reminders to partners for overdue receivables. there are two ways to do this: from the information bar: a reminder can be sent straight from the overdue invoice list, without opening the invoice. from the payment reminder menu: several invoices can be selected at once, and you can decide which ones receive an informal and which ones a formal reminder. late payment interest request the system can send a late payment interest request letter, together with the interest charge itself. notification frequency for late payment here you can set how often the system should send payment reminders or formal notices to partners in arrears.

6.2.9 product variants if you have many essentially identical items — differing only in one property — the size of the product master data can be reduced by creating product variants. the variants are subordinated to the main product. product variants receive a unique, configurable item number: the item number of the main product is supplemented with the variant code. every variant inherits the data of the main product, but it can also have a different price. goods receipt with variants: when receiving the main item: all assigned variants can be received at once, at the same purchase price, with a quantity per variant with variant-level receipt: the quantity and the purchase price are given individually only the product variants can be sold, not the main item. at stocktaking you can take stock of the main product, or you can do it separately per variant. first define the distinguishing properties (for example colour, size) as product attributes: then create the individual product variants. for example for products in different colours: add every possible colour as an attribute, create the main product, and the system then generates the new item number per variant. both the product attributes and the product variants can be extended at will. at goods receipt you can choose from the following options: receive the main item (same price, quantity per variant) receive the variants one by one (individual price and quantity per variant) note only the product variants can be sold, not the main item.
6.2.10 product history for products with serial number management, the movements related to the product can be listed by entering the serial number; otherwise by entering the item number.

6.2.12 bulk pricing from a file for price changes in large volumes, an excel-based import is also possible. after downloading the sample file, enter the item number and the new price. in the pricing window on the right, specify the currency, the price type and the validity date. clicking the upload button loads the prices temporarily (this does not overwrite the existing ones yet). if you are satisfied with the result, click the save all changes button.

6.2.13 creating a price list you can create a price list from the existing products for your partners. select the products, add them to the list with the select button, then export them in the required currency and price type.

6.4.4 transfer between warehouses to move stock between warehouses, first select the source warehouse, then the target warehouse. from the products with current stock in the source warehouse, select the items to be transferred. the transaction is finalised with the close button. a transfer subject to approval is also possible: the goods leave the source warehouse when saved, but the system keeps them as stock in transit until they are received in the target warehouse.

6.4.5 scrapping used to write worn-out or damaged goods off stock. the reason for the scrapping has to be given (this also appears on the scrapping report). after selecting the items, close the document — the scrapped goods are written off stock with a scrap issue movement.

6.4.6 stocktaking as a first step, specify the warehouse to be counted, or upload the stocktaking file (the sample can be downloaded from the stocktaking screen). after the warehouse has been selected, infinity lists the stock it contains. if you are only counting a few items, select them manually; if the whole warehouse, click the select all marker. after selecting the items, click the select button: once the items to be counted have been selected, the warehouse movements can be locked. click the lock warehouse button and specify the start of the lock. caution during the lock, no sales, goods issue, goods receipt or transfer between warehouses can be performed from that warehouse. if someone attempts it, the system stops with a warning message. enter the physically counted quantities on the stocktaking sheet. items can be searched for in the product search box. the difference column shows the deviation between the quantities in infinity and those actually counted. if you find an item that is not in the system, you can look it up in the add product field and add it to the list (only an item recorded beforehand can be added). once every item has been counted and recorded, click the close stocktaking button. the system then lists the items showing a deviation separately. clicking the print stocktaking report button gives you the report as a pdf. to write off a deviation: in the inventory → warehouse management → stocktakings menu you can encounter stocktakings with three statuses: started a stocktaking sheet that has been started but not yet closed completed a closed stocktaking written off a closed stocktaking with the stocktaking deviations written off with a stocktaking in completed status you can do two things: accept the results and press the write off deviation button, or have it recounted with the reopen button. after reopening, the quantities recorded earlier are already there; only the recounted quantities have to be entered.
6.4.7 stock receipt in this menu you can receive, check, correct and approve the imported stock.
6.4.8 stock receipt pending items if products are added to stock with approval, you can approve and finalise them here. after the approval, the products are added to stock and become sellable.

6.4.9 stock movements the stocks in the system can be moved (for example from consignment stock to own stock). select the warehouse and the stock, add the items, then specify the target stock and the quantity. after saving, the transaction becomes final.

6.5 edi report inventory infinity makes it possible to send and receive various edi reports. the format of the data exchange depends on the provider; the parameterisation has to be carried out on the basis of the specification supplied by the edi provider. the function enables fully automatic data exchange and the automation of manual processes.

7.1.4 documents awaiting approval – information bar the approving user finds the documents awaiting approval in their information bar. if several users have to approve and the current one has already approved, their item turns green. to withdraw the approval, click the item again and reject it. from the list you can reach the document to be approved with a single click. the list contains all the necessary information, including the number of approval points received so far. in the approval window you can send a message to the issuer of the document or to the other approver. with the approve field you approve the document (as many points are recorded as the approval protocol prescribes). in the case of rejection, minus points are assigned. caution if a document under approval is modified, all approval points are deleted and the approval process starts again.

7.1.5 filing register when creating the digital filing register, enter the name of the register and the prefix and suffix of its serial number. in the register list, add the user who has permission to use it. the system automatically creates a filing register in which it places the documents. the filing process: the user uploads the document into the filing widget under the document upload tab on the home page. the documents are placed in a list, which the authorised user sees on the home page under the my tasks tab. the user categorises the documents one by one, marks the partner or employee (not mandatory), places the document in the filing register, then presses the filing button. the document receives a filing number and a time stamp; the name of the filing user is also stored. the user assigns the document to a division or to one or more users. the designated user processes the document by clicking the process button. types of the filed document: invoice: clicking the filing button opens the invoice entry page, the document is attached automatically and the partner is already selected employee document: the employee document screen opens, where the division and the employees have to be selected general document: the basic upload screen appears, where the document is archived for the given partner

8.1 settings accounting in the accounting settings you can control for which source documents a cost centre and a project number can be entered at creation, and you can also give them default values.

8.2 accounting periods accounting the accounting periods control whether analytical and accounting documents can be modified. two kinds of period can be created: accounting period: controls whether accounting documents can be edited and created analytical period: controls whether source documents can be edited and created this duality is needed so that an open accounting period can be ensured for the accounting team while no more economic events are generated. during stocktaking, for example, it is possible to prevent all document creation except the creation of stocktaking documents. data of the list manager: period, first day of the period, last day of the period, accounting/analytical selectable field, status. possible values of the status: new: only master data can be created for the period, documents cannot be recorded open: documents can be recorded and modified closed: created by a general ledger closing; only reports can be retrieved and documents displayed the analytical period controls that: on a customer invoice item: the fulfilment date and the document date can only fall within the open analytical period on a supplier invoice item: the fulfilment deadline, the general ledger date and the vat date have to fall within the open analytical period on warehouse movements: the document date can only fall within the open analytical period the date of bank and cash desk documents can also only fall within the open analytical period ⚠ caution only one accounting period can be in open status at a time. all the others have to be closed.

8.3 automatic posting accounting on this screen you can set the rules according to which the accounting document is produced from the source documents. automatic posting does two things: it creates an accounting document from the source document (finance → cash movements → transaction list) it extends the data of the source document with the information given in the automatic posting rule automatic posting rules can be defined per accounting document group. these create the accounting documents in posted status as soon as the source document is completed. if an automatically created accounting document is produced in normal status, it has to be checked and set to posted. setting up the automatic postings is careful work, since this determines how much manual effort the handling of accounting documents will require. an automatic posting rule consists of two parts: the part identifying the source document and one particular transaction line of it the part containing those parameters of the source document that have to be met for the automatic posting to apply automatic posting rules can be set up for the following analytical documents: invoice-based sales supplier invoice cash desk receipt and payment document documents of bank transfers listing accounting documents documents created by automatic postings only reach posted status if: the balance of the debit and credit sides is zero every line contains a general ledger account the mandatory cost centre and job number are given everywhere if any of the conditions is not met, the document is produced in normal status and has to be corrected — either on the source document (for example a missing cost centre) or directly on the accounting document (for example a missing general ledger account).

8.4 general ledger accounting the general ledger module collects and organises the data from the other modules. whether a given document reaches the general ledger depends on the posting configured during parameterisation. the type of posting can be twofold: automatic posting: based on the automatic posting rules, the given document reaches the general ledger automatically manual posting: the user selects manually from the postable general ledger accounts the only transaction created exclusively in the general ledger module is the mixed type posting, which can be applied to every item not related to any other module (for example wages and contributions, taxes, openings, closings, transfers). the collection is made on general ledger accounts, which can be extended with a further dimension by using cost centres and job numbers. posting details it is not necessary to place every analytical document under automatic posting. in the posting data menu you can simply set which ones you define automatic posting for. project numbers / job numbers the system also allows a project or job number to be recorded, which can be linked to a partner and/or a warehouse. the system uses this number for posting as well. a project number, a name, the partner and/or the warehouse, and the status (active/inactive) have to be given.

8.4.2 project numbers / job numbers the system also allows a project or job number to be recorded, which can be linked to a partner and/or a warehouse. the system uses this number for posting as well. a project number, a name, the partner and/or the warehouse, and the status (active/inactive) have to be given.

8.5 depreciation types accounting the type of depreciation can generally be: straight-line: distributes the value of the asset evenly over the useful life — the same amount of depreciation in every period straight-line with period control: different multipliers can be defined for different periods immediate write-off: the method applied to low-value assets, with which the full value of the asset can be accounted for as depreciation in the year of acquisition in the input field, enter the code and the rate of the depreciation and select its type. this code can be entered at the depreciation of the given asset.
8.6 asset groups accounting when creating an asset group, specify the characteristics of the given asset group and the parameters of the accounts related to posting the depreciation.
8.7 storage locations accounting here you can create a physical or person-related storage location, to which a cost centre can also be assigned.
8.8 fixed assets accounting  fixed asset list to add a fixed asset, click the create button, then fill in the data relating to the asset.
8.8.1 fixed asset list to add a fixed asset, click the create button, then fill in the data relating to the asset.

8.9 fixed asset movement types accounting a movement type also has to be recorded for the assets, which determines the type of the asset's primary movement (for example acquisition of a new asset, depreciation) and the secondary type linked to the primary movement (for example contribution in kind, planned depreciation).

8.10 chart of accounts accounting here you can add, modify and import the chart of accounts (the sample import file can be downloaded from the screen). an account group has to be given for every account recorded in the master data — infinity handles these groups during the individual transactions. the general ledger master data can be built up in a tree structure, with postable and non-postable (collective) accounts. when creating the general ledger master data you can control whether posting to the given general ledger account has to be made at cost centre and job number level. if so, these have to be given obligatorily when the invoice is issued or when the automatic posting is defined.
9 orders orders the orders menu covers the entire sales process: quotation, order and invoicing. these functions can be operated in connection with each other as well as independently.

9.1 quotations orders following an enquiry from the customer, a quotation is prepared and sent to the customer; if the response is positive, the order is recorded. quotations issued to customers are recorded in the orders → create quotation menu. when preparing a quotation you can specify the freight forwarder partner, the payment method and currency, the estimated delivery time, the discount and the end of validity. items recorded in the product master data can be included at the recorded prices, at prices reduced by a discount, or at an individual price. the items added to the quotation can be edited and deleted afterwards. after recording, the quotation has to be closed — it can then be printed and sent out. the items on the quotation do not have to be in stock; a quotation does not reserve stock. the possible statuses of quotations: open editable, non-final quotation closed saved quotation in closed status ordered quotation converted into an order failed its validity has expired, or the partner rejected it deleted withdrawn or reversed quotation for a returning customer or a similar sale, clicking the “new quotation based on this” button copies the original quotation, while every piece of data remains editable. completed quotations can be printed to pdf and sent to the partner manually or with the automatic e-mail function. the partner can respond with acceptance or rejection using the buttons in the e-mail. on acceptance, the status of the quotation changes to accepted / ordered and the system automatically creates the customer order. on rejection, the reason for the rejection can also be given. ✓ accepting the quotation and creating the order is fully automatic — there is no need to create an order manually.

9.2 customer orders orders an order can be created in two ways: directly with the new order menu (without a quotation), or from a quotation by clicking the order button. when created from a quotation, it is filled in with the quotation's data, but every field remains editable. if the customer accepts the quotation, the system automatically converts it into an order, which appears among the orders with open status. ℹ if the customer accepted the quotation and the system created the order automatically, pressing the reserve button lets you check whether every item is in stock. saving the order means reserving from stock. if a product on the order is not in stock, the order cannot be closed and a purchase order has to be started for it by pressing the start order button. the possible statuses of orders: open saved order, does not have a serial number yet, editable reserved already reserves stock, awaiting fulfilment deleted reversed order, the stock reservation is released fulfilled delivered and invoiced order in the header of the order — directly below the title — the document chain bar appears. from here, both the source quotation and the related purchase order can be reached with a single click, without having to return to the list view. ⚠ if the order was created automatically from a quotation, the chain appears automatically. if the order was created manually (not from a quotation), the chain only points towards the purchase order. pressing the invoicing button converts the order into a customer invoice with a single click. if several orders have been fulfilled for one partner, the bulk sales button on the order list invoices all of them at once.

9.3 purchase orders orders the purchase order module is available in the orders → purchase orders menu. creating a purchase order from the customer order this is the most common case — in the event of a shortage, it can be started from the customer order: open the customer order in view mode. click the + create purchase order button (at the bottom). the products awaiting procurement pop-up window appears (with a red header). check the quantities and the suppliers. click the + create purchase order button (blue, at the top). recording a confirmation when the supplier has confirmed the order (quantity and deadline), it has to be recorded as follows: open the purchase order. at the items, click the pencil icon on the left of the row — the “edit procurement item” page opens. at the top of the page you can see the name of the product, its item number and the current in stock and reserved values. scroll down to the confirmations section. enter the confirmed quantity (primary) value and the confirmed date. click the + add button. save the item with the save button. ℹ several confirmation lines can be added to one item if the supplier confirms in parts — a separate date and quantity can be given for each line. ✓ after the confirmation has been recorded, the red 0 / 259.00 value at the item turns green: 259.00 / 259.00 ✓ ⚠ when the finalise button is clicked, a confirmation window appears: “are you sure you want to finalise? after this operation, items can no longer be added or deleted.” the operation cannot be undone. finalisation and goods receipt once every item has been confirmed and the shipment has arrived: click the finalise button — confirm in the pop-up window. the status of the purchase order changes to confirmed. to start the goods receipt, click the closing method button (bottom left). closing method — two options option when effect closing with approval if check required = yes the approver also has to accept it closing immediately if check required = no (default) creates the warehouse movement immediately, stock increases ✓ after closing, press the reserve button on the customer order — the items previously marked awaiting procurement now move to reserved: final status.

9.5.1 unas api keys a new webshop can be added with add new (a name, a description and an api key are required). only api keys with active status are synchronised. conditions for unas to run: an invoice-issuing company must exist among the sites of the invoice issuer, at least one must be a main site the main site must have a normal customer invoice block there must be at least one active api key the background processes must be set up correctly

9.5.2 unas order log clicking the run download process button downloads the orders with invoiceable status from the webshop. based on the order identifier, the system checks that anything already invoiced is not downloaded again. during order synchronisation the following data are generated: partners, addresses, contact details, products, vat rates, financial transactions, sales, invoices. if the run status of the order log is not completed but failed or waiting, open the log for the error message. in case of an error, click the download button next to the key on the unas api keys screen — this immediately downloads every order that has not been downloaded.

9.5.3 partner synchronisation partners are only downloaded when the order is generated. a new partner is created based on an e-mail address check. if the e-mail already exists in the system, only the billing and address data are refreshed (this does not affect invoices issued earlier). for a partner with a tax number, the system takes over the tax number in an unchanged format (the validation is performed when the invoice is issued). if the tax number is incorrect, an open sale is created when the order is downloaded, and an error message indicates the problem when the invoice is opened.

9.5.4 product synchronisation – object links basic conditions of synchronisation: the background process must be active the product must have an item number, a name, a category, a selling price and a product image one of the above has to change (synchronisation is triggered by a change) on the unas object links → product screen you can define, from the product master data, what is published to the webshop. the left and right columns can be linked; the items linked with the api key appear on the given website. one product can be linked to several api keys. the add link button finalises the link and the remove button deletes it. the last refreshed field shows the date of the most recent synchronisation. for the first time, or for a campaign-like refresh, you can use the synchronise all button (it performs the synchronisation even without a change). ⚠ caution in the information bar you can continuously check which product's list price expires within 5 days. expiring prices have to be modified or extended, because unas treats items without a price as erroneous. product images are synchronised as well, but unas only takes over the image if no image has been uploaded for the item on the website yet.

9.5.5 category synchronisation when managing products, the categories linked to the product are generated in the webshop as well (with the full path). this menu serves exclusively for synchronising categories that are not linked to a product.

9.5.6 warehouse synchronisation here you specify which warehouse's stock the webshop uses. stock synchronisation only runs for items that have already been created. ℹ note both the warehouse and the item have to be linked with the active api key. by default, synchronisation is only triggered by a stock movement; with the full sync button the stock can be refreshed even without a warehouse movement.

9.5.7 unas synchronisation log used to check the running of the background synchronisation procedure. in case of an error, here you can see for which products and warehouses the synchronisation did not run and what the reason was. after the correction, the background process runs again automatically.

9.5.8 settling unas invoices automatic settlement is possible for both cash and card invoices (when the invoice is issued, the settlement document is also created and the balance of the invoice becomes zero). for a cash invoice, only one setting is required. for card invoices, the system only settles automatically if it receives the “payment successfully completed” status from the unas website and the amount matches the amount of the order.

10.1 menu structure and search hr the main path of the hr process: settings → position → recruitment → offer → hiring → onboarding → active employee → termination → reports. in the menu on the left, under the hr module, you find the following main menu items: positions recruitment employees documents and records working time and scheduling leave management assets and handover settings (with submenus) almost every list view has a search and filter panel. using the filters does not only make things easier to find: the reports and the dashboard use the same dimensions (department, manager, period).

10.2 saving, logging, permissions hr when saving, the system logs most transaction steps (who changed what and when). if a field appears greyed out, this usually means that the data were already recorded in an earlier process step (for example the position at hiring), and can only be modified with a separate “change form”.

10.3 hr dashboard – daily control panel (beta) hr the hr dashboard is the starting page of the daily work. it is not a collection of statistics but an operational control panel: it shows where things are stuck and what the next urgent task is. kpi cards at the top the kpi cards are quick status indicators. for example: active employees, open positions, candidates in progress, onboarding delays. when clicked, the system jumps to the related list with the filter already applied. recruitment block here you see the distribution of the candidates across the selection steps in a consolidated form. if one column is disproportionately high, there is a bottleneck there (for example too many candidates waiting for an interview). onboarding block around new arrivals, the biggest risk is that not everything is ready for the first day. the dashboard therefore separately indicates the people starting today and tomorrow and the missing mandatory tasks (for example a laptop). alerts the alerts list only contains items that require action (for example: end of probation approaching, offer without a reply, late onboarding task). clicking the alert opens the detailed record.

10.13 termination / offboarding hr termination is the controlled closing of the employment relationship. the system does not delete data: it archives the employee, closes the employment relationship and (optionally) starts the it offboarding tasks. starting the termination you start the termination on the employee's record with the “terminate” button. the button is typically only active for hr_admin. open the employee's record. click: terminate. fill in the dates (last working day, date of termination). select the reason for the termination. set whether it offboarding should start and whether assets have to be returned. finalise. field type mandatory? explanation / tips last working day date yes until when they actually work. date of termination date yes the end of the employment relationship; end_date in the system. reason for termination enum yes resignation / mutual agreement / dismissal / probation unsuccessful / expiry / other. comment long text conditional mandatory if the reason is “other” or of a disciplinary nature. rehire eligible yes/no no whether they can be re-employed later; useful for reports. it offboarding check box no if switched on, it tasks are generated. assets list no laptop/phone/card; it helps with the handover. documents file no attaching the notice or the agreement. what happens after finalisation? the system sets the status of the employee to terminated, fills in the end_date field, and the employee is removed from the active list. the employee's data remain available in the archive (terminated) list. if it offboarding is active, the related tasks and integration triggers are started as well. important! after the termination we do not delete the employee record. this is necessary for the reports and the audit.

12.1 receipt-based sales settings invoicing setting up the basic data related to receipt-based sales so that this form of selling is quick and simple.

12.2 invoice-based sales invoicing a vat-registered taxable person is obliged to issue an invoice to the buyer for the supply of goods and services performed domestically for consideration. select the customer (or add a new one). in the product search, find the product by scanning a barcode, entering the item number, searching by name, or using the product search button. an item can also be searched by item number, ean code, serial number, foreign item number and name. in the edit item pop-up window, enter the quantity and, if needed, change the price (both net and gross can be entered). for a product with serial number management, the serial number can be chosen from a drop-down list. the comment cell serves for item-level comments; for internal accounting, a cost centre and a job number can be given both in the header and on the item. the save button adds the item to the invoice. the items of an open invoice can be edited and deleted. on one invoice either a gross item discount or a percentage or fixed-amount total discount can be given. first select the discount type, then enter the amount — the save button updates the item prices. the payment deadline is automatically the issue date plus the deadline set on the partner record. the comment field serves for a comment covering the whole invoice. the default payment method can be changed and combined with other methods. for cash payment, automatic printing of the cash desk document can be set for card payment, the card transaction identifier has to be entered for voucher payment, the voucher number has to be entered every payment method must be added with the + sign; it can be corrected with the red bin sign the close button generates the invoice and assigns a serial number. invoices created this way can be viewed in the invoicing → sales menu. ℹ note the information bar on the home page notifies you about sales that were left open and not closed. closed invoices are submitted to the nav online system immediately by a background process. the invoice can be printed as a pdf and sent by e-mail. when the invoice is issued, the warranty certificate recorded for the product is generated automatically. advance invoice and final invoice click the issue invoice button and switch on advance invoice to create an advance invoice. after that, only the advance item can be selected. when producing the final invoice, find the advance invoice in infinity by its number. the final invoice is produced with the final invoicing button — the advance appears on it with a negative sign. returns returns can only be processed from the invoicing → sales menu. clicking the return button displays the invoice items and the quantities sold. after entering the quantities to be returned, select the method of refund and click next. credit note after an invoice has been issued, a discount can be granted on the sale with a credit note. a credit note can only be issued from the invoicing → sales menu. it can be issued for the full t

12.3 receipt-based sales invoicing below a value limit of huf 900,000 including vat, if the buyer is not a taxable person and does not request an invoice, the business is obliged to issue a receipt. the receipt can only be issued on paper, in hungarian. the receipt must contain: the date of issue, its serial number, the tax number, name and address of the issuer, and the consideration of the product or service including tax. the product can be selected by scanning a barcode or by typing the name or item number manually. the product can also be selected from a drop-down window. an item-level discount, a percentage or fixed-amount discount on the total, or an individual price can be given. to correct, click the orange pencil button; to delete, the remove items button. for mixed payment, add every payment instrument with the + sign. if the amount and the payments match, the transaction can be closed. ⚠ caution before pressing the paid button, the customer must in all cases have settled the purchase financially. printing the receipt also produces the warehouse issue and the cash receipt document at the same time. with a loyalty programme, enter the loyalty card number before saving the receipt. if the card number is incorrect or expired, infinity displays a warning.

12.4 sales invoicing here you find all sales — those issued automatically, those based on data arriving from the webshop, and those issued manually. reversal, credit note, return, copying, printing and sending by e-mail can all be carried out from here. the invoice list is also directly accessible from this page.

12.5 nav online invoices invoicing customer invoices the list of invoices that have been issued and uploaded to the nav online system, and the place where resending and checking are carried out. the statuses: done (green) submitted successfully, nothing to do aborted / bad (pink) the invoice was not submitted, or was submitted unsuccessfully — manual upload is required on the nav interface supplier invoices infinity also downloads the invoices issued to us from the nav system. clicking the eye icon lets you view the details of the invoice: the items can be matched with the products stored in the product list, or a new one can be created. after that, the supplier invoice can easily be recorded in the system.

12.6 automatic invoices invoicing the place for automatically generating invoices that are issued regularly, repeatedly, with the same parameters. based on the parameters set here, the system generates customer invoices at defined intervals. important: tick the check required box if you want to review or modify the invoice before it is issued (in that case it is created with open status). if you do not tick it, the invoice is generated automatically and, in the electronic case, sent out as well. fill in the basic data, the parameters of the invoice comment and the scheduling: use the add item button to add the items to the invoice. after saving, the activate button puts it live and the deactivate button stops it.

12.7 certificates of completion invoicing issuing and sending certificates of completion from the system. for a new certificate of completion, click the create button, fill in the partner data and add the items. the save button saves it, the close button finalises it and sends it to the partner by e-mail. the copy button simplifies issuing. in the list, the certificates can be resent, deleted and modified.

13.3 projects crm three kinds of project can be recorded: normal project: it enables sales and customer management customer service project: for handling customer service type tasks project management project: for general project management the project record consists of three sections: basic data, supplementary data (owner, start, duration, end date, expected project value), other (priority, room). to create a new project, enter a name (it does not have to be unique): normal project: if you select a modifiable workflow, the system offers the events assigned to that workflow from a drop-down menu. if you do not fill it in, you can freely choose an event type. the type can be normal or customer service. in the case of customer service, the data of the e-mail address receiving the reports has to be entered — the system displays the incoming e-mails in the given crm project. the owner can be selected from the partner list. when the start date is entered, the system checks whether the owner has a booking (sick leave, holiday, another crm event). if so, a warning message appears and the event cannot be saved. the expected project value can be compared in the statements with the working time cost spent.

13.4 workflow crm for creating automated workflows (for example from the quotation to issuing the invoice). in the project, the record follows the workflow through; the status of the event always stands at the current value, then switches to the next one after closing. when creating a new workflow, give it a name (an active workflow can be selected for a project; an inactive one cannot). the expiry of the workflow means that if nothing changes either before or after the deadline, a warning message is sent to the owner with this delay.

13.5 crm contacts crm the place for adding and managing contact persons. the following can be recorded: surname, first name, name of the organisation, e-mail, phone number, status, address, tags and custom fields. a contact person can be added with the new contact button or by importing from an excel file (a sample file can be downloaded). contact persons can be assigned to a company (converted into a partner), or a new company can be created for them. one contact can be linked to several companies. the projects concerned are accessible from the contact's record.

16.1 users system  users a screen for maintaining the users of the system. handling it requires appropriate care. mandatory fields when creating a new user: login name password (at least 8 characters) status: an inactive user cannot sign in role: determines the scope of permissions of the user fields that are not mandatory but are required for use: current issuing partner: required for invoice issuing activity current site: also important for invoice issuing partner identifier: useful for tracking user logs and for activity-bound processes roles different permission systems can be assigned to different job functions. the advantages: irrelevant activities can be excluded, and a simpler, cleaner working screen can be created. ⚠ caution before the system is introduced, the range of job functions and the required permissions have to be assessed. managing roles requires considerable expertise — a careless intervention can cause irreversible damage! a role can be copied, or modified after opening it. further permissions can be added to a role by typing in the search window and then selecting from the list that appears. deletion can be performed on the user maintenance screen. smart groups the permission system of infinity has two levels: first the basic functions are set in the role matrix, then the detailed permissions within the individual roles. smart groups are loaded during migration, but they can be refined further in the system → users → smart groups menu. if a new permission is added to a smart group, it changes automatically in every role the smart group is assigned to. steps of usage: adding a smart group: system → users → smart groups menu adding permissions to the smart group: assign the activities that are needed together assigning the smart group to a role: the role automatically inherits the permissions of the smart group this solution significantly simplifies permission management and reduces the possibility of errors.
